verdict.rationale: Outbound event callbacks are a fair question for an AI coding agent, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Aider offering registrable webhooks. Its programmatic surface is an unsupported Python scripting API with no HTTP API. The --watch-files feature only watches local files for AI comments; it does not send outbound HTTP callbacks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
